Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.

Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CUTN Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN) for filling temporary positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by CUTN?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Guest Faculty in the discipline of Physics for the academic session.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty position in the Physics department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form via email is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for CUTN Guest Faculty Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through email to the designated recruitment email address provided by the university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject along with a NET qualification or a Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 1500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified or required to be paid according to the official notification details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 70 years specifically for superannuated teachers applying for the position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of CUTN?
faq.answer: You can visit the official CUTN website at cutn.ac.in to access detailed notifications and updates.
